I need to know what time it will be in both these cities when it's 2pm in New York. Second, I am considering switching to solar energy for my home in California and I want to understand the potential greenhouse gas emissions I could save. I plan to use it for 12 months. Can you calculate the emission savings for me?"

energy_type.description: Type of the renewable energy source.

region.description: The region where you use energy. Default is 'global'.
